name: card
title: Card
description: Card parts: a titled card renders as a section labelled by its title, with an eyebrow, a top-end action slot, a heading level on the title and card, dashed or bare surfaces.
docs: A `Card` renders `<section>`; once it holds a `CardTitle` it gets `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title, so it is a named region. Give the title `headingLevel` to make it a heading. `CardEyebrow` sits above the title, `CardAction` at the top end of `CardHeader`. `surface` is `card` (default), `dashed` or `none`. To keep a card out of the landmarks (a card per list item), pass `render={<div />}` or `render={<li />}`.
